profile.address: 1 Hearst Field Annex, Building C Berkeley, CA 94720-1060
profile.summary: The Center for Educational Partnerships is a unit of the University of California, Berkeley. It provides outreach and engagement with students, families and educators from kindergarten through community college to increase access to higher education. It runs ten programs, including direct services to students and families and professional development for educators.
